description:
Windows Installer Packaging Tool for Developers, ISVs & Enterprises

Advanced Installer is a Windows installer authoring tool for installing, updating, and configuring your products safely, securely, and reliably.
New Features
- ClearType text support in WinUI views and installer themes

Enhancements
- Support for importing Visual Studio .slnx files
- Update MSIX schema to 26H2
- PowerShell automation for Exit Dialog actions
- PowerShell automation for adding a Temporary Folder
- PowerShell automation for Azure Key Vault Login Type
- Add descriptions for all PowerShell automation properties and methods
- New Enhanced UI attribute to show password visibility on request
- New UI option in "Registry entry" properties to deploy registry entries across all user profiles
- Improved consistency of Help, OK, and Cancel buttons on application dialogs
- File associations for Advanced Installer templates
- "Install folder content into the parent folder" option available from the command line
- Self-contained support for the IntuneHelperWinRT module
- Improved the Extended Identity OID field synchronization
- Enhanced UX when creating custom dialogs with custom size
- New "Do not store password" option for scheduled tasks
- Updated .NET 8 prerequisites to the latest version 8.0.33
- Updated .NET 9 prerequisites to the latest version 9.0.22
- Updated .NET 10 prerequisites to the latest version 10.0.14

Fixed Bugs
- Security: Enforced strict TLS certificate validation across shared HTTP client connections
- Security: Hardened digital signature verification for custom EXE detection in the Updater
- Security: Restricted VMLauncher.exe temp folder sharing to strictly required files during "Run in VM" execution
- Scheduled tasks' secure properties unresolved at install time for "Run whether the user is logged on or not"
- Prerequisite install actions were not preserved in the main setup log file during a silent installation
- Exit/Save dialog buttons were hidden when using monitors with different DPIs
- Chained prerequisites were not reinstalled when repairing the main package
- Cached EXE installer was removed during a silent installation
- Convert paths wizard became unresponsive when using projects with a large number of files
- PowerShell automation - IniFilesComponent.Files getter returned all entries from the INI file
- AIP file became corrupted when using the "Copy to output directory" option for Companion files in the Visual Studio extension
- Next button incorrectly updated to "Install" text on Serene theme
- Project file was changed automatically when visiting the "Organization" page
- Forcing dark theme in the App Installer theme no longer worked when using a "Set installer property" custom action
- FilesInUse dialog was not rendered as expected when using an EXE package in the App Installer theme
- Repackager failed to reconnect to Windows Sandbox after guest OS reboot
- Kazakh language strings rendered as missing-glyph boxes in the installer Welcome dialog
- Prerequisites set to install before the main package but after a Framework prerequisite were skipped if Windows 10 x64 was disabled
- Next/Install button remained disabled in the Serene theme's LicenseAgreementDlg when using WinUI
- The "Sign in / Register" button showed its own tab in the taskbar
- "Copy to User Profile" custom action did not work after it was renamed
- PSF Tracing failed when InstalledLocationVirtualization declaration was present
- Already installed feature-based prerequisite was incorrectly selected with "Skip" action on the PrerequisitesDlg
- Build error (MSI API 1627) when building a project with a Scheduled Task that had no schedule entries
- "Do not display country name in language selection combo" option was visible in Updates and MSM project files
- Fixed an issue where the Enhanced UI uninstaller executable was not digitally signed during the build process
- Ignore Package Files option did not work correctly in a Patch project when multiple files were added at once
- Incorrect landing page for the F1 shortcut key of the "Digital Signature" view in the Updates Configuration project
